tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide background. Light slides carry the story; dark slides mark the cover, the turning point, the climax and the closer.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Second light background, for primers, proof points and guardrails, so long light runs don't blur together.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card fill, on surface or surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px card borders and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Card borders on surface-alt, where line is too faint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text, on surface, surface-alt and card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body text and labels, on surface, surface-alt and card.

tokens.name: ink-struck
tokens.usage: The crossed-out before value in a before/after pair. Always pair with line-through and a word like Before; color never carries it alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, big numbers, after values, the highlighted card's 2px border and arrows. As text, on surface, surface-alt and card.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Step numbers, item names in mono, icons and code keys. As text, on surface, surface-alt and card.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The one dark card on a light slide (what worked, what's next). Text on it uses the dark theme's ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code and config panels. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: Keys and folder names in code panels, on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Values in code panels, on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Punctuation, comments and tree lines in code panels, on code-bg.

tokens.name: slate-900
tokens.usage: Palette: deep slate. The dark slide background and code panels.

tokens.name: slate-800
tokens.usage: Palette: card fill on dark slides.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Palette: borders and dividers on dark slides.

tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Palette: card fill on light slides.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Palette: light slide background and text on dark slides.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: Palette: second light background.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Palette: amber on dark slides, the 24px edge stripe on the cover, climax and closer.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Palette: amber as text on light slides (5:1 on paper-100).

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Palette: blue on dark slides and in code panels.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Palette: blue as text and icons on light slides.

groups.name: Slide type
groups.note: Sizes are on the 1920×1080 slide canvas. Five sizes do all the work: 120, 72, 44, 32, 28, with 24 for labels. Nothing smaller than 24.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover titles and big numbers. One per slide.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide headings, at the top margin on every slide.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The memorable line, outcome titles, the struck before value.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A ten-minute answer can sit in a queue for days.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Write the role and the policy

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: JetBrains Mono marks anything technical or structural.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above every slide title, in accent.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Step numbers, item names, code panels, teaser footers.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a big number and its label.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between lines inside a card.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a slide (eyebrow, title, content).

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between big numbers side by side.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Padding on every slide; content sits in 1664×824.

tokens.name: footer-offset
tokens.usage: A footer line sits 64px from the bottom; that slide's bottom padding grows to 160px.

tokens.name: edge-stripe
tokens.usage: Width of the amber stripe on the left edge of the cover, climax and closer.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, code panels and the cover's before/after panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and tags.
